title: Syrian Lamb Flatbreads
description: A flavorful and aromatic flatbread recipe topped with tender lamb and a hint of spice, inspired by Syrian cuisine.

ingredients.name: Lamb
ingredients.notes: Ground lamb is best for this recipe

ingredients.name: Flatbread
ingredients.notes: Homemade or store-bought flatbread works well

ingredients.name: Syrian
ingredients.notes: Syrian spice blend adds a rich flavor to the dish

ingredients.name: nutty
ingredients.notes: A hint of nutmeg adds warmth to the dish

ingredients.name: Silky
ingredients.notes: Honey adds a touch of sweetness to balance the flavors

instructions: In a large pan, cook the ground lamb over medium heat until browned, breaking it up into small pieces as it cooks.
Add the Syrian spice blend, nutmeg, and honey to the pan and stir to combine.
Warm the flatbread in the oven for 2-3 minutes.
Place the flatbread on a baking sheet and top with the lamb mixture, dividing it evenly among the four flatbreads.
Return the flatbreads to the oven and bake for an additional 5-7 minutes, until the lamb is heated through and the flatbread is crispy.
